copy.title: Boltman Locksmiths — Meet Your Local Boltman
copy.description: Boltman Locksmiths: one trusted local locksmith per town, eight towns — Aylesbury, Batley, Huyton, Newport, Pudsey, Seaham, Stanford-le-Hope and Warrington. The old way of hiring a tradesman, kept alive.
copy.topbar: One town. One Boltman. One number that gets answered.
copy.h1: Remember when you just knew a locksmith?
copy.lead: Not a call centre, not a franchise directory — a person. Boltman keeps that old arrangement alive in eight towns: one trusted local locksmith per town, on a number the neighbours already have saved. From Aylesbury to Warrington, if your town's on the list, you've got a Boltman.
copy.heroNote: {n} towns, {n} locksmiths. That's the whole company, and that's the point.

about.heading: How Boltman works
body: Every trade used to work this way: a town had its locksmith, everyone knew who he was, and his reputation walked down the high street ahead of him. Boltman is that model, deliberately kept small. Each of our {n} towns has one dedicated locksmith — vetted, DBS-checked, insured — who covers that town and nowhere else.

It changes the economics of trust. Your Boltman can't hide behind a brand's reviews, because in Pudsey or Seaham the reviews are about him, personally. He answers his own phone, quotes his own jobs, and sees the same faces at the school gates as his customers do. Cut corners once in a town that size and everyone hears about it — so nobody does.

The trade-off is honest: we can't cover everywhere, and we won't pretend to. But if your town is one of ours, you get something the national firms can't sell — a locksmith who is genuinely, permanently local.

coverage.heading: Find your town, meet your Boltman
coverage.intro: Eight towns, eight locksmiths, eight direct numbers. The areas on each card are your Boltman's daily rounds.

services.heading: Everything you'd ask the town locksmith to do
services.intro: The full trade, done properly, by the same pair of hands every time.
featured: Call your Boltman direct — he knows the estates and he's rarely far. Non-destructive entry as standard.
New home, lost keys, ex-keyholders — sorted in one visit, with keys cut and handed over on the doorstep.
Sticking, stiff or tired locks brought back to life — the small jobs national firms won't get out of the van for.
24/7, because that's what being the town's locksmith means. Nights are answered by the same person as afternoons.
Insurance-standard locks fitted and explained across the kitchen table, not sold from a script.
After a break-in you want a familiar face, fast. Your Boltman makes safe, repairs and helps with the insurance notes.

cta.heading: Is your town a Boltman town?
cta.sub: Check the list — and if it is, save his number before you need it.

copy.footerBlurb: Boltman Locksmiths — one trusted local locksmith per town, in eight towns across England. The old way of hiring a tradesman, kept alive on purpose.
